title: The Lone Stars group after AAWSAP

tellings.quote: so they formed this informal group which is called the the Lone Stars.

plain: Around 2010, after the end of AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded program that studied unexplained phenomena, some of the people involved formed an informal group called the Lone Stars. A researcher and witness named Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source, and mentions the figures Jacques Vallée, Eric W. Davis and Hal Puthoff. If true, the study carried on quietly after official funding stopped.
